acceptanceCriteria: A spec (or affected-plan-v0 amendment) records the Java adapter's ownership (.java, and whether Gradle/Maven build files are owned), unit shape, test discovery and frontiers.
A Java affected.Language adapter is registered in languages.All(); kotlin and Java cross-reach is either modelled or reported as a frontier; shell.ForeignSourceSuffixes includes .java.
Unresolved imports, reflection and build-graph reach abstain as UNKNOWN; the adapter passes the seam conformance suite.
corvint affected on a Java fixture selects tests with DEPENDENCY_PATH witnesses; focused tests and one independent review are retained.
body: Observed 2026-10-12 during V1-1301 on origin/main 9deae4838 (corvint built from the V1-1301 worktree). internal/liveverify/affected/kotlin/kotlin.go owns only .kt and .kts, and no other registered plugin in languages.All() owns .java, so a dirty .java path is UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH: the plan stays UNKNOWN and names no test. The V1-1301 gap answer and ticket body wrongly said kotlin covers Java/Gradle. V1-0594 covers JVM runner execution, not affected selection. Expected: a dirty .java source selects the JUnit/TestNG tests that import it (package/import edges, same-package reach, src/main <-> src/test layout), with UNKNOWN on reflection, annotation processing and build-graph reach. Actual: UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH. Once a plugin owns .java, add it to shell.ForeignSourceSuffixes (languages_test enforces the sync).
title: affected: add a Java test-selection adapter (.java has no plugin; kotlin owns only .kt/.kts)
